usedFor: Zite stores records, and “When a new record is created” runs “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new record is created” in Zite, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new record can share a link to its related file.
